Trade-offs — 权衡；取舍
A Greener Street: Weighing the Trade-offs

discuss — 讨论
[A] Last month, the Riverside Community Group met to discuss a plan for Green Street.

cost — 费用；成本
However, some people are worried about the cost and the changes.

raise — 筹集
Therefore, we need to raise 6,000 yuan.” Mr.

parking — 停车；停车位
Li, a shop owner, said, “If you take away parking spaces for bike lanes, some customers will go to other streets.

gardener — 园丁
We could also ask a gardener for advice.” Mr.

suggested — 建议（suggest的过去式）
Li suggested, “Why don’t we keep some parking and add trees only?

noise — 噪音
Then we can have cleaner air and no lost parking.” Another member said, “We must not forget the noise.
